text:
[issue by ToxinZangoose]
Hello,

I have recently been trying to diagnose an issue with my modpack and the log files point to this mod when I try launching.

When launching, owo lib tries to load shaders for Spectrum which is not supported for NeoForge.

Below is the log file for the crash I've been experiencing since I've tried removing 19 mods from this pack.

https://mclo.gs/wDKVGtH 

Thank you for your time!

With how neo handles crashing it tends to blame Owo when someone in the mod loading chain crashes. This error shows up before so possibly a issue with such mod
